profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Data & Full‑Stack)
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software engineer, data engineer & sometimes data scientist. Energetic leader with strong interpersonal skills. Strategic thinker. Broad experience in many different business roles. Excellent at defining customer needs and driving to meet them. Sub 3 hour marathoner, obstacle racer, bootcamp leader.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development of the Python SDK for creating and managing data quality assertions in bulk, now in use by major customers. Solicited feedback throughout from interested potential customers. Greatly simplified the interface and set the groundwork for future work including YAML based configuration using the new interface. Approx 70k LoC with 1.6 test to code ratio.
- Developed several full stack features for Observe - the data quality testing tool within DataHub - using React, Typescript, Python, Java, Kafka.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Top 10 contributor to the core open source library (top 1% of PyPI downloads, 10k+ GitHub stars) with 500+ PRs merged and major contributor to GX Cloud. Stood up the internal rotation for community PR reviews.
- Led development of a full-stack feature to compute and display summary metrics, enabling end to end use by non-technical users for the first time.
- Led development of automated expectation generation (Core and Cloud), changing how users onboard and configure data tests.
- Core developer of Scheduler, Runner, and Dynamic Parameters features (AWS EventBridge, Localstack, DataDog, Sentry, ArgoCD). Gave internal engineering talks to share knowledge.
- Collaborated with Databricks, Prefect, and Dagster on integrations. Temporarily led analytics efforts and staffed the analytics team.
- Key Technologies Used: Python, React, Typescript, GraphQL, FastAPI, Pydantic, Poetry, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, GCP, Athena, BigQuery, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Databricks, PySpark, pandas, SQL, scikit-learn.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React.js · SQL · Snowflake · Databricks · Kubernetes · Data Engineering · Git · GitHub · Amazon Redshift · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: CTO / Co-founder
positions.description: Designed specialized data tools to support infrastructure developers and investors using OCR + ML + heuristics.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Microsoft PowerPoint · Data Engineering · Git · GitHub · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Director Of Analytics
positions.description:
• Championed the importance of in-house analytics capabilities and created a new team.
• Created a Celery-task and Django-based ETL system with logging, scheduling, data validation and a web UI similar to dbt + Airflow + Great Expectations, resulting in a >10x improvement in report and metric generation speed and data quality.
• Built and managed robust ETL and reverse ETL pipelines handling over 1 billion events, 200+ visualized metrics, 50+ self-service reports and data visualizations.
• Designed and built an ML-based lead scoring and account health system, to improve the accuracy of lead qualification and account monitoring.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Amazon Redshift · Data Engineering · Data Visualization · Git · GitHub

positions.title: Strategic Advisor
positions.description:
• Spearheaded a strategic evaluation, restructure and revitalization effort that led to the company's attainment of award-winning profitability.
• Slashed proposal turnaround time, boosted revenue by almost twofold, and fostered a metrics-driven and success-oriented organizational culture.
• http://www.djshome.com

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
• Built the initial proof of concept software and subsequent prototype software and hardware for an AI based driver distraction reduction device, proving the concept and leading to over $170m in VC funding.
• Created an Android application (Java) to validate the feasibility of collecting vehicle data. Built the backend with AWS (S3, EC2, RDS - postgresql).
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Git · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Product Manager | Program Manager | Business Development
positions.description:
• Developed the largest megawatt class permanent magnet direct drive wind turbine. Led a team that grew from less than 10 to over 65, with a $10M+ budget. Implemented several systems that augmented productivity.
• Created financial models to estimate energy yields and compute project-specific pricing.
• Averted a potential multi-million dollar disaster by emphasizing the need for safety and manufacturing completion checks.

positions.title: Project Manager/Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Directed the development and pre-production readiness of an ultracapacitor-based energy storage system for a hybrid electric vehicle.

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
positions.description: Led design and R&D projects, earning distinctions such as 2 R&D author’s awards and a scholarship to fund MS degree. Managed interns and co-op students. Patent #20100038056. MA EIT Cert. #21923.
